outcome: Neonatal outcomes (birth weight, Apgar scores, congenital anomalies)
cohort: Women who conceived through ART compared to those who conceived naturally
finding: Pregnancies conceived through ART were associated with a higher risk of maternal complications, including gestational diabetes and hypertensive disorders, as well as a slightly increased risk of preterm birth, but no significant differences in neonatal outcomes.
birth_weight: Measured, but no significant difference reported between groups
